updates.title: Build Tracker - Foundation & Deploy
updates.description: Built the entire foundation for tracking 25 days of shipping. Created a brutalist-themed web app with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Designed multi-project data architecture to track 3 concurrent products. Deployed to both Vercel and GitHub Pages for public tracking.
highlights: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite setup
Brutalist design system with pixel borders and retro fonts
Multi-project tracker architecture (Build Tracker, DevSpeed CLI, QuickAPI)
Calendar grid with 25 days and status tracking
Deployed to Vercel + GitHub Pages
Project filtering and modal detail views
Responsive grid layout with pixel art aesthetic

updates.title: Calendar Dates & UI Polish
updates.description: Added real calendar date tracking to align the 25-day challenge with actual dates (Dec 21 → Jan 14). Completely redesigned the UI with day numbers as the hero element, making it bold and impactful. Improved visual hierarchy with status badges, inverted header design, and better stats display.
highlights: Real calendar date support with startDate tracking
Days auto-lock until their actual date arrives
Massive day numbers (6xl-7xl) as primary visual focus
Calendar dates small and subtle (12px, 50% opacity)
Status badges repositioned to top-left (DONE/WIP/LOCKED)
Inverted header: black background, white text
Big number stats badges with colored backgrounds
Project emoji badges in top-right of cards
Comprehensive project documentation in .claude/CLAUDE.md

updates.title: Mind Galaxy - Initial Setup
updates.description: Started a new AI-powered note-catching app to help capture and organize fleeting thoughts. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, integrated with Google Gemini API for intelligent thought organization. Designed to help users quickly sort their minds, unload mental burdens, and identify connections between ideas.
highlights: React + TypeScript + Vite foundation
Google Gemini API integration for AI-powered organization
Project structure with components and services
Environment configuration for API keys
Initial repository setup and documentation
5 commits establishing core architecture

updates.title: View Switcher & UX Polish
updates.description: Added calendar/cards view toggle and moved project filters to always-visible pills for easier navigation. Compact calendar design makes it easy to scan release dates at a glance, while the new monthly goal tracker (3/8 DEC GOAL) helps maintain sprint focus.
highlights: Calendar/Cards view switcher with icon-only mobile design
Project filters as visible pills (ALL, BUILD TRACKER, MIND GALAXY)
Compact calendar - reduced sizing for better scanning
Monthly goal tracker badge (X/8 DEC GOAL)
Future cards hide dates until release
Only released items show actual dates
Improved mobile touch interactions

updates.title: Visual Clustering & Node Design
updates.description: Enhanced thought visualization with improved cluster logic for stronger visual grouping of related nodes. Updated node design to minimal dots with hover text and top 3 connection highlighting, creating clearer relationship hierarchies.
highlights: Tightened initial layout for better clustering
Leveraged existing physics parameters for stronger visual grouping
Minimal dot design for cleaner interface
Hover text for node details
Top 3 connection highlighting for relationship hierarchy
Clearer visualization of related thoughts
